name: Assemble P104 owned772 DFT submission

# Upload this workflow and p104-owned772-delta.zip to a NEW builder branch.
# The push trigger starts the assembly automatically.
# Destination branch selected by the submitter: pr-halitziyav5-pre-pi.
# workflow_dispatch is optional (GitHub requires workflow on default branch to expose manual Run).
on:
  push:
    paths:
      - "p104-owned772-delta.zip"
      - ".github/workflows/assemble-p104-owned772.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      output_branch:
        description: "New PR branch name (leave empty to use DEFAULT_PR_BRANCH below)"
        type: string
        required: false
        default: ""

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: p104-owned772-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  assemble:
    if: github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' && github.ref != 'refs/heads/master'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      DEFAULT_PR_BRANCH: "pr-halitziyav5-pre-pi"
      REQUESTED_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.output_branch }}
      UPSTREAM: "https://github.com/bigospeedrun/verifier.git"
      # Published PR #41 is the source of the 381 byte-identical inherited files.
      BASELINE_COMMIT: "0efdd614a4ecae5b114c46f1fd8b153cd0f10f7f"
      SOURCE: "submissions/dft/halitziyakartal-halitziyav4-logception"
      DEST: "submissions/dft/halitziyakartal-halitziyav5-pre-pi"
      ZIP: "p104-owned772-delta.zip"
      EXPECTED_HASH: "a8506c23fc59aac4fce9b704de320074ec418bf4ef87247c1f298c0404412b34"

    steps:
      - name: Checkout builder branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Assemble and verify exact 426-file submission
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PR_BRANCH="${REQUESTED_BRANCH:-$DEFAULT_PR_BRANCH}"
          git check-ref-format --branch "$PR_BRANCH" >/dev/null
          if [[ "$PR_BRANCH" == main || "$PR_BRANCH" == master || "$PR_BRANCH" == "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Choose a NEW PR branch, separate from main and the builder branch."
            exit 1
          fi
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "refs/heads/$PR_BRANCH" > /dev/null; then
            echo "::error::Branch '$PR_BRANCH' already exists; refusing to overwrite or force-push."
            exit 1
          fi
          test -f "$ZIP" || { echo "::error::Upload $ZIP to this builder branch."; exit 1; }
          T="$(mktemp -d)"
          trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$T/delta" "$T/base"
          unzip -tq "$ZIP"
          unzip -q "$ZIP" -d "$T/delta"

          # Load historical source commit AND recent upstream main, independently.
          git fetch -q --no-tags --depth=1 "$UPSTREAM" "$BASELINE_COMMIT"
          git fetch -q --no-tags --depth=1 "$UPSTREAM" main
          git checkout -q -B "$PR_BRANCH" FETCH_HEAD
          git archive "$BASELINE_COMMIT" "$SOURCE" | tar -xf - -C "$T/base"

          python3 - "$T" "$SOURCE" "$DEST" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import shutil
          import sys

          temp, source, dest = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]), Path(sys.argv[3])
          delta, baseline = temp / "delta", temp / "base" / source
          keep = (delta / "keep.txt").read_text().splitlines()
          changed = sorted(f for f in (delta / "files").rglob("*") if f.is_file())
          for relative in keep:
              path = Path(relative)
              assert not path.is_absolute() and ".." not in path.parts
              original, output = baseline / path, dest / path
              assert original.is_file(), f"Inherited file missing: {path}"
              output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
              shutil.copyfile(original, output)
          for incoming in changed:
              path = incoming.relative_to(delta / "files")
              assert not path.is_absolute() and ".." not in path.parts
              output = dest / path
              assert not output.exists(), f"Conflicting source: {path}"
              output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
              shutil.copyfile(incoming, output)
          all_files = [f for f in dest.rglob("*") if f.is_file()]
          assert len(keep) == 381 and len(changed) == 45 and len(all_files) == 426, (
              len(keep), len(changed), len(all_files)
          )
          print(f"Assembled {len(all_files)} files ({len(keep)} inherited + {len(changed)} overlay)")
          PY

          (cd "$DEST" && sha256sum --quiet -c "$T/delta/expected.sha256")
          SUM=$(cd "$DEST" && find . -type f -print0 | LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
          echo "Assembled folder SHA-256: $SUM"
          test "$SUM" = "$EXPECTED_HASH" || { echo "::error::Folder checksum mismatch; nothing pushed."; exit 1; }

          git add -- "$DEST"
          git -c user.name="github-actions[bot]" -c user.email="41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com" commit -m "DFT submission: saving 312780997/100000000000"
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$PR_BRANCH"
          echo "SUCCESS: verified complete submission pushed to branch '$PR_BRANCH'"
          echo "Open a PR from '$PR_BRANCH' to bigospeedrun/verifier:main manually."
